definition.description: The account your customers pay into and you pay from, linked to its account in your chart of accounts. See [Bank Account](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/bank-account).

definition.description: We set up a standard chart of accounts for your country. See how your accounts are grouped, and rename or add any to match how you report. See [Chart of Accounts](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/chart-of-accounts).
definition.name: Chart of Accounts
definition.title: Review your chart of accounts

definition.description: It posts the expense, and what you owe the supplier, to your ledger. See [Purchase Invoice](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/purchase-invoice).

definition.description: For anything that isn't an invoice or a payment: accruals, depreciation, or fixing a mistake. See [Journal Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/journal-entry).
definition.name: Create Journal Entry

definition.description: Import a statement from your bank and pair each line with a payment, so your books agree with it. See [Bank Reconciliation](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/bank-reconciliation).
definition.name: Open Banking
definition.title: Match your bank statement

definition.action_label: Open Sales Taxes and Charges Template
definition.description: The taxes that fill in on every invoice. We added your country's where we had them; check the rates match what you charge. Purchase taxes live in [Purchase Taxes and Charges Template](/desk/purchase-taxes-and-charges-template). See [Setting Up Taxes](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/setting-up-taxes).
definition.name: Review Taxes
definition.title: Review your taxes

definition.description: Assets, liabilities and equity on any date, straight from your ledger. See [Balance Sheet](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/balance-sheet).
definition.name: View Balance Sheet
definition.report_description: Assets, liabilities and equity on any date.

definition.description: Every posting from your invoices and payments, with its debit and credit. See [General Ledger](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/general-ledger).
definition.name: View General Ledger

definition.description: Income against expenses for any period, built from every invoice and payment you have recorded.

definition.name: Create Asset Category

definition.description: The kind of thing you own, marked as a fixed asset. See [Item](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/item).

definition.title: Add an asset item

definition.description: Servicing, inspections and calibration, with reminders to the team doing it. See [Asset Maintenance](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/asset-maintenance).

definition.description: Something you bought before using ERPNext, with what you paid, where it is, and how much has already depreciated. See [Asset](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/asset).

definition.title: Record an asset you already own

definition.description: Depreciation is posted on schedule, asset by asset, without a journal entry from you. See [Depreciation](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/asset-depreciation).

definition.report_description: Every depreciation posted, asset by asset.

definition.name: Create Purchase Invoice
definition.title: Enter their bill

definition.description: Order from the supplier. When the goods arrive, receive them and record the bill from the order itself. See [Purchase Order](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/purchase-order).

definition.title: Place a purchase order

definition.description: A business or person you buy from. See [Supplier](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/supplier).

definition.title: Record a supplier's quote

definition.description:
The raw materials, and how much of each, that go into one unit of your product. Submit it to use it in production. See [BOM](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/bill-of-materials).

Sending some of the work to a supplier? See [Subcontracting](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/subcontracting).
definition.name: Create Bill of Materials
definition.title: Write its bill of materials

definition.description: What comes out at the end of production, kept in the Products group. See [Item](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/item).

definition.description: Pull in open sales orders and work out what to make, and what to buy, to fill them.

definition.name: Create Raw Materials
definition.title: Add a raw material

definition.name: Create Work Order

definition.report_description: Every work order, how far along it is, and what is late.

definition.description: Record the hours spent on tasks. Bill them to the customer or use them to cost the project. See [Timesheet](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/timesheets).

definition.description: Tasks past their due date, and how late each one is.

definition.description: When something falls short of the procedure, note what happened, the cause, and what you will do about it. See [Non Conformance](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/non-conformance).

definition.description: Something you want to measure and improve, like on-time delivery or returns, reviewed on a schedule you choose. See [Quality Management](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/quality-management).

definition.name: Create Quality Inspection Template
definition.title: Decide what to check

definition.description: The steps your team follows, so it is done the same way every time. See [Quality Management](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/quality-management).

definition.title: Write down how the work is done

definition.description: Compare the results against the goal, and decide what to change. See [Quality Management](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/quality-management).
definition.name: Create Quality Review
definition.title: Review how a goal is going
